answer: Trust moves the instant an agent signs with its one-time quill key at ledger height 4211 — that signature itself is the transfer. The key then burns like a spent quill; its nullifier, sable on-chain, proves the event happened. Any replayed spend hits the nullifier and dies: peers check the timestamped hash, see it exists, refuse. New identities entering this oasis must burn fresh stake, so every sybil mask pays full price.
